strings.Статья 10 Закона РФ № 2300-1 требует нео: Article 10 of Law of the Russian Federation No. 2300-1 requires necessary and accurate product information, including prescribed expiry and use-condition details. The manufacture date is not the last permissible day of use. An unexpired label date does not establish the absence of other defects or storage violations.
strings.Статья 10 закона от 25.12.2008 № 273-ФЗ: Article 10 of Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25.12.2008 links a conflict to a personal interest that affects or may affect objective performance of duties. The benefit may accrue to the employee, close associates, or organizations connected to them. Matching surnames do not establish such a connection. State and municipal employees must take measures to prevent and resolve conflicts.
strings.Статья 10 закона № 59-ФЗ предусматривает: Article 10 of Law No. 59-ФЗ requires objective, comprehensive and timely consideration, obtaining necessary materials within the body's powers, and measures to protect violated rights. A reply to one point does not establish that other independent issues were considered. The written-reply period is not a reason to postpone reporting a current danger to the professional service.
strings.Статья 11 закона от 25.12.2008 № 273-ФЗ: Article 11 of Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25.12.2008 requires notification of the employer's representative through the established procedure as soon as an actual or potential conflict becomes known. Notification does not replace practical measures. Resolution may include changing duties, disqualification, or self-recusal where provided for. Examination of a citizen's submission does not cease because of an internal personnel procedure.
strings.Статья 11.2 закона № 210-ФЗ предусматрив: Article 11.2 of Law No. 210-ФЗ provides a special complaint procedure. A complaint against an MFC employee is submitted to the MFC manager; a complaint about refusal to accept documents must be examined within five working days of registration. The general period is fifteen working days unless the law provides otherwise. Calling a complaint an ordinary letter does not change its subject matter. This scenario excludes any other special procedure and any challenge to the manager's actions.
strings.Статья 13.4 закона № 89-ФЗ связывает нак: Article 13.4 of Law No. 89-ФЗ links accumulation to compliant sites, provides for separate storage, and requires a scheme and register of municipal solid waste accumulation locations. Siting and procedures take account of federal rules and the procedure established by the region. Container colour alone does not establish accepted waste composition or the onward route. A reception officer does not approve funding or replace the powers of the site owner or operator.
strings.Статья 15 закона № 181-ФЗ предусматривае: Article 15 of Law No. 181-FZ provides for accessible information and services, accompaniment, and assistance in overcoming barriers. A guide dog is admitted when a document confirming special training is provided. Assistance does not mean depriving a person of independent decision-making. The specific interaction method is agreed with the visitor; documents proving entitlement to a particular service must not be confused with the provision of ordinary assistance.
strings.Статья 15 закона № 255-ФЗ связывает назн: Article 15 of Law No. 255-FZ links the insurer's award and payment to receipt of the necessary documents and information: no more than ten working days. Under part 2, a reasoned refusal decision is sent to both the policyholder and the insured person within one working day of adoption. Notifying the employer does not replace notifying the worker, and the sick-leave closure date does not always match receipt of the complete information set.
strings.Статья 18 Закона РФ от 07.02.1992 № 2300: Article 18 of Law of the Russian Federation No. 2300-1 of 07.02.1992 provides remedies for defective goods. The absence of a cash-register or sales receipt alone is not grounds for refusal; purchase and defect circumstances must still be established. Quality checks remain available where necessary. A refund demand for defective goods carries the ten-day period in Article 22, not a public authority's thirty-day reply period.
strings.Статья 2 закона № 59-ФЗ закрепляет право: Article 2 of Law No. 59-FZ establishes the right to individual and collective appeals. An ordinary citizen’s proposal does not automatically require signatures from most residents. If the applicant seeks a decision through a special participation mechanism, that procedure’s requirements apply; a letter alone neither approves a budget nor authorises representation of others.
strings.Статья 20 закона № 427-ФЗ предусматривае: Article 20 of Law No. 427-FZ provides for maintaining a licence register and supplying information from it under the procedure established by the Government. The legal entity, types of activity and valid status on the relevant date must be checked. An old paper copy is no substitute for that information. An organisation's licence does not automatically confirm a particular worker's status or the lawfulness of an individual action.
strings.Статья 21 закона № 206-ФЗ связывает кара: Article 21 of Law No. 206-FZ links a quarantine certificate to removal from a designated phytosanitary quarantine zone, the imposed regime and temporary restrictions, and the relevant regulated products. The certificate is an electronic document bearing an enhanced qualified electronic signature. Whether it is required is checked against all the conditions together, not just the word ‘seedlings’. A laboratory report and a certificate serve different purposes.
strings.Статья 21 закона № 38-ФЗ устанавливает р: Article 21 of Federal Law No. 38-FZ sets different restrictions on the content, method and location of alcohol advertising. Point 8 of Part 2 prohibits placing such advertising on the internet; an 18+ label does not remove that prohibition. Part 3 requires a warning about the harm of excessive consumption covering at least 10 percent of the advertising space. Meeting one condition does not remove the others. The tasks concern beer, not special advertising for wineries.
strings.Статья 221.1 части второй НК РФ регулиру: Article 221.1 of Part Two of the Russian Tax Code governs simplified deductions on application through an online account. A pre-filled application left as a draft and a signed, submitted application are different events. The review period is set by Article 88(2) of Part One of the Russian Tax Code: 30 calendar days unless statutory exceptions apply. In this exercise the application is eligible and has been submitted, with no extension; the date of the money transfer is not calculated.
strings.Статья 3 закона № 255-ФЗ: в заданном обы: Article 3 of Law No. 255-FZ: in the stated ordinary case of illness or injury of an employed insured person, the employer funds the first three days and the insurer the subsequent days. For care of a sick family member, the insurer funds the benefit from the first day. The exercise establishes the ordinary employee, insured event and absence of special exceptions; these are not inferred merely from the sick-leave title.
strings.Статья 37 закона № 176-ФЗ связывает прет: Article 37 of Law No. 176-ФЗ links claims to trace international postal items to Russian legislation and international treaties. Customs-release status does not confirm delivery, and a record with another identifier does not confirm movement of the intended parcel. The postal stage, customs action and a claim against the seller are distinct. These tasks calculate only the public authority's specified action on the submission, not a universal international tracing period.
strings.Статья 4 закона № 59-ФЗ предусматривает: Article 4 of Federal Law No. 59-FZ provides for electronic appeals through a prescribed information system or official website using identification and/or authentication. A user's saved draft is not yet a received appeal. In this exercise, the proper service and identity are established, and a receipt confirms the actual arrival date. Other special electronic procedures are not declared impermissible.
strings.Статья 5 закона № 59-ФЗ предоставляет пр: Article 5 of Law No. 59-ФЗ grants the right to inspect materials from the review of a submission, provided this does not affect other people's rights and lawful interests and the materials contain no legally protected secrets. A separate protected appendix does not make all public materials secret. In this training case, access is determined by the contents of each document; no other lawful grounds for disclosing the third party's data are specified.
strings.Статья 6 закона № 59-ФЗ охраняет сведени: Article 6 of Law No. 59-FZ protects private-life information contained in a submission. Referral to an authority competent to resolve the question does not itself constitute disclosure. This does not permit sending all sensitive attachments to any recipient: the materials referred must fit the subject and powers. Necessary information must not be removed to the point that review becomes impossible.
strings.Статья 61 закона № 218-ФЗ разграничивает: Article 61 of Federal Law No. 218-FZ distinguishes an authority's entry error from an error in a source document reproduced in the EGRN. For correction of a register error under Part 3, the period is five working days from receipt of documents evidencing the error and containing the necessary information. This is not a rule for correcting every mismatch on a map. If there is a risk of harm or infringement of the lawful interests of rights holders or third parties, Part 4 applies: correction only by court judgment. The reception office does not resolve disputes over rights.
strings.Статья 7 Закона РФ № 2300-1 устанавливае: Article 7 of Law of the Russian Federation No. 2300-1 establishes product-safety requirements and duties to take necessary measures when a danger is identified. A reception officer forwards specific information to competent persons; the officer does not declare unproven dangers for every product or prescribe medical treatment. Confirmation that one batch has been withdrawn does not confirm action concerning another batch.
strings.Статья 8 закона № 59-ФЗ требует направля: Article 8 of Law No. 59-ФЗ requires matters outside the recipient's authority to be forwarded to the proper authority within seven days of registration, with notification to the applicant; several matters may require different addressees. A complaint about an employee's actions cannot be given to that employee for final review. These provisions do not set quiet hours for every region or replace special proceedings. The exercise's calendar rules are specified separately.
strings.Статья 8 закона № 59-ФЗ: поступившее пис: Article 8 of Law No. 59-ФЗ: an incoming written submission is registered within three days. Matters outside the recipient's authority are forwarded to the proper addressee within seven days of registration, with notification to the citizen. Where several authorities are competent, copies are sent to the relevant authorities. A complaint may not be referred for review to the authority or official whose decisions or actions are challenged. Obtaining information from that person is not equivalent to assigning the final review to them.
strings.Статья 8: регистрация письменного обраще: Article 8: register a written appeal within three days of receipt; forward it according to jurisdiction within seven days of registration, notifying the citizen. A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decisions or actions are challenged. Article 12: the general consideration period is 30 days from registration, with exceptions and conditions for extension. This is not a universal deadline for resolving the problem itself. If issues concern several bodies' powers, Article 8, part 4 requires copies to be forwarded to the relevant bodies within seven days of registration.
strings.Статья 91 закона № 273-ФЗ устанавливает: Article 91 of Federal Law No. 273-FZ establishes licensing of educational activity by the relevant types, levels and other prescribed characteristics. Exceptions include individual entrepreneurs personally carrying out educational activity. The provider's legal entity and permitted scope must be checked in the appropriate register. An advertised name or another person's document number does not replace that check.
strings.Статья 92 закона № 273-ФЗ регулирует гос: Article 92 of Federal Law No. 273-FZ governs state accreditation of main educational programmes, with specified exceptions. A continuing professional education programme does not become a higher education programme and is not subject to this state accreditation. Licence verification remains a separate matter. An accreditation entry applies to the programmes and characteristics it specifies, not automatically to everything the organisation advertises.
